state.recurrence_source: 1857 Fort Tejon M~7.9 rupture (last major event on this section). Recurrence estimates vary by study/sub-segment: Wallace Creek/Carrizo geological slip-rate method ~260-340 yr; trenching interval to prior event (~1480) ~370-380 yr; UCERF-style Mojave-specific paleoseismic recurrence commonly cited ~150-200 yr for M7+. Used 150 yr (lower/more conservative end) pending a dedicated re-check -- WIDER UNCERTAINTY than SJC's Hog Lake figure, flag this when interpreting C_state for this segment.
